held_one_reader.medi_said: الكبار مش الـ uh, ما بـ... ما لبسنا
held_one_reader.why: Subject is الكبار (they) so the verb is لبسوا not لبسنا (we); Amal recast and asked why; he accepted 'It would be لبسوا?'.
held_one_reader.english: Some of the adults didn't wear costumes.

held_one_reader.why: 'one of the pastries' (the ones at the party he just named) is definite and needs el- after من; let pass.
held_one_reader.english: One of the pastries, for example.

held_one_reader.medi_said: I think it was like مختلف، خضرة مختلف.
held_one_reader.why: خضرة is feminine so the adjective is مختلفة; inside an English sentence and let pass.

held_one_reader.medi_said: شو عادةً كان في-- Or شو عادةً في معجنات؟
held_one_reader.amal_said: (none; she said شو فيه بالمعجنات at 16:45)
held_one_reader.why: Pastries in general take el- after في (Amal's own بالمعجنات); English drops 'the', Levantine keeps it. Let pass.
held_one_reader.r3_why: Real let-pass, low; D5 (preposition + generic noun keeps el-) fits better than A1.

held_one_reader.medi_said: طلبت غير تاني. No، إشي غير منهم.
held_one_reader.why: 8eir goes before the noun; Amal recast غير إشي and he said 'غير always comes before the noun' (37:57).
held_one_reader.english: I asked them for something else.

held_one_reader.why: He meant 'first thing in the morning' (her chat awal el-subu7, the أول she asked him to use) but said أوّل مرة (first time); Amal did not voice it; he restarted with أوّل الصبح at 42:23.
held_one_reader.english: I read the news first thing in the morning.
held_one_reader.r3_why: Wrong phrase for the meaning; she let it pass, so B, low.

held_one_reader.medi_said: الإشي المفضل عندي إنه or اللي...
held_one_reader.amal_said: You don't need anything actually just. ... Cuz it's is.
held_one_reader.chat: el-ishi el-mufaddal 3indi lamma ana at6alla3 3ala el-6abi3a
held_one_reader.why: He put إنه / اللي where English has 'is'; Amal said nothing is needed 'cuz it's is' (no word for to be); his 'No, no, no' came after her 50:09 line.
held_one_reader.english: My favorite thing is when I look at nature.
held_one_reader.r3_why: Her voiced 'you don't need anything' came before his own no.
